title: Meta wants to pay for its broad AI buildout with a newly created class of stock | TechCrunch
summary: On Wednesday, as the company reported its third-quarter earnings, Semafor reported the company might issue non-voting stock, meaning shares that don’t give their owners a vote on company decisions, to help fund its push into artificial intelligence.
